def: OpenAI's V4A patch format and the tool built on it, in which a patch creates, updates or deletes files and locates each change by context lines instead of line numbers.
practice: Patches sit between *** Begin Patch and *** End Patch, and OpenAI says GPT-4.1 was extensively trained on the format; with the Responses API apply_patch tool the model emits operations that your own harness applies.
